name: @thoremin/sources
description: thoremin's media sources, framework-free: one SourceAdapter per provider (registered as data: search, resolve a link or an id, open a playback session), the rights profile each item carries and the core enforces, the PlaybackSession transport seam, and the first adapters: a local file, a CORS URL, Audius and the Internet Archive (TypeScript source, consumed through the workspace).
